finalText:
Migration done. All 12 app files switched `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, syntax-checked clean.

One holdout left: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` — still on `db.query`. Left untouched on purpose: file header says it's a vendored copy, overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, local edits silently lost. Fixing it here won't stick. Real fix needs to happen upstream in the legacy-orm package itself, or wrap it with an adapter shim outside the vendor dir if you need it converted now.
